name: T'ville Bushwalking Club February meeting
description:
Let's kick the year off with a bang.  Do you have a new year's resolution or intention to get outdoors and explore?
If so, come along to the first Club meeting of the year to register your interest in joining a walk in February. 
Next walk is scheduled for 17 February.

WHERE: Blessed Mary Mackillop Parish meeting room (building behind the Church), 43 Ross River Road Mundingburra
TIME:  6pm (meetings usually go for about 45mins)

RSVP: no need to RSVP, just turn up 

Please direct any questions to the Club via email tsvbush@hotmail.com

Happy walking!
